oval_asym.description: Asymmetric oval. 13.5 m main straight, a long 180 deg curve of radius 3.2 m, a gentle kink on the back straight and two tighter corners of different radius (1.6 m and 2.0 m) on the other end.

technical_s.description: Technical track: two hairpins (a tight one of two 1.4 m arcs and a mixed one of 2.6 m + 1.4 m arcs), chains of S-bends made of alternating left/right 90 deg arcs of 1.5 m and a long main straight.

urban_grid.description: Urban circuit: eight corners close to 90 deg (radius 1.3-1.5 m) with a Z-shaped jog, streets of 1.8-2.1 m between tall building walls, dead-end side streets (alcoves) and a plaza with low curbs where the LiDAR sees open space.

slalom_cones.description: Stadium loop with a kinked back straight and two slalom sections of alternating cones with variable spacing (2.5-3.6 m), wide lanes and lateral oscillations of +-0.42 m.

boot_lshape.description: L-shaped "boot" circuit inspired by the real APEX track (docs/reports/ Piste.jpeg), mirrored and scaled x1.5 to respect the turning radius: narrow 1.3 m corridor between continuous walls, a U-turn at the tip of the extension, a diagonal S-neck joining both parts and 90 deg corners.

val_mixed.description: Validation track (never in train): bean-shaped loop with a concave section, a chicane, and lane width changing from 1.5 m to 2.6 m, mixing straights, open and tight curves.

test_unseen.description: Test track (never in train or validation): decreasing-radius spiral corner, double-apex curve, a wide section with pillars in the lane that force a pillar chicane, a hairpin and a long diagonal straight.

zs_warehouse_aisles.description: ZERO-SHOT (not in any database): warehouse loop through long aisles of repetitive shelving; nearly parallel, feature-poor walls make LiDAR translation weakly observable along the aisle.

zs_roundabout_city.description: ZERO-SHOT (not in any database): city loop with a roundabout-like right-left-right sequence and junctions at non-90 deg angles.

zs_real_track_replica.description: ZERO-SHOT (not in any database): estimated real-scale replica of the APEX track in docs/reports/Piste.jpeg (about 8 x 5.5 m, 1.1 m corridor, 1.0 m corners close to the steering limit, diagonal S-neck, U-turn tip), surrounded by tables and people as in the photo. Dimensions are estimated from the photo (car used as scale), not measured.
